notes.title: Update 1.1 adds Color Blindness mode, new vfx and bug fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Enhanced Accessibility for Color Blindness: Protanopia, Protanomaly, Deuteranopia, Deuteranomaly, Tritanopia, Tritanomaly, Achromatopsia, Achromatomaly 
[*] Additional VFX for the connections
[*] Archive: See the stars in 3D
[*] Small Bug Fixes (Character Size proportions, instruction screen navigation, mouse over fx on main menu texts, stars archive not revealing stars)
[/list]
